title: Adaptive Protection for Evolutionary Feature Construction in Symbolic Regression with Application to Credit Classification
abstract: arXiv:2608.14209v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Evolutionary feature construction has shown strong promise in symbolic regression by automatically discovering informative transformations of input features that enhance a simple base learner. However, existing approaches often lack explicit mechanisms to preserve important constructed features discovered during evolution, and valuable genetic material can be lost when genetic operators disrupt effective features. This paper introduces an adaptive protection mechanism that leverages feature importance metrics to selectively preserve constructed features during evolution. The mechanism provides stronger protection for more important constructed features while still allowing less important features to be modified and to incorporate useful building blocks from more important features. We evaluate the approach using multiple feature importance calculation methods and demonstrate its robustness across different base learners. Experimental res

translated_title: 自适应保护机制在符号回归中进化特征构造的应用及其在信用分类中的表现
translated_abstract: 进化特征构造在符号回归中展现出强大潜力，它通过自动发现输入特征的信息性变换来增强简单基学习器的性能。然而，现有方法通常缺乏显式机制来保留进化过程中发现的重要构造特征，当遗传算子破坏有效特征时，宝贵的遗传物质可能会丢失。本文引入一种自适应保护机制，利用特征重要性度量在进化过程中选择性保留构造特征。该机制对更重要的构造特征提供更强的保护，同时允许较不重要的特征被修改，并从更重要的特征中整合有用的构建块。我们使用多种特征重要性计算方法评估该方法，并证明其在不同基学习器上的鲁棒性。实验结果...
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于特征重要性度量的自适应保护机制，在符号回归进化过程中选择性保留重要构造特征，从而防止有效特征丢失并提升信用分类性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an adaptive protection mechanism based on feature importance metrics to selectively preserve important constructed features during symbolic regression evolution, preventing loss of effective features and improving credit classification performance.
